summary: A consumer retrieved a reviewed workaround, applied it, hit an incident, and reverted; the retrieval was correct by every dimension the selection carries and was still wrong.
no_deployment_because: the change was reverted before release, so the deploy system holds no record of it
no_post_deployment_because: nothing was deployed to observe; the incident that prompted the revert was raised against the merge, not against a release

prior_learning.why: the timeout-semantics workaround recorded by the other consumer matched on every dimension the selection carries

instances.subject: timeout-semantics workaround
instances.why_not_useful: the workaround encoded the other consumer's assumption about retry budgets, which this service does not share; repository, capability, environment, stage and work type all matched, and none of them is the dimension that mattered

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: the applied workaround produced an incident within the observation window and the change was reverted before release
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: the incident system, which is the outcome authority for this record rather than anything the registry inferred
